name: RDPEGFX Shadow Alignment
description: Ralph-ready RDPEGFX shadow alignment plan for OmniRDP. The work hardens the viewer-side RDPEGFX path so it behaves like a reliable shadow framebuffer publisher: coordinate validation, RDPEGFX command bounds checks, per-viewer dirty accumulation, bounded coalescing, producer/client race safety, ACK/backpressure pacing, conservative fallback controls, surface lifecycle cleanup, diagnostics, and validation evidence. Backend codec negotiation must remain unchanged; do not enable backend NSCodec, RemoteFX, or backend GFX.

userStories.title: Audit and enforce dirty rectangle coordinate convention
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want all framebuffer, dirty-region, and RDPEGFX dirty command code to use one documented rectangle convention so incremental updates cannot be corrupted by off-by-one or clipping errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Document in code comments that RECTANGLE_16 dirty rectangles use inclusive left, top, right, and bottom coordinates.
Audit framebuffer dirty collection, publisher snapshots, RDPEGFX dirty command construction, and pending dirty helper code for the inclusive coordinate convention.
Reject or clamp invalid rectangles before they enter any RDPEGFX pending dirty accumulator or outgoing dirty snapshot.
Add tests for one-pixel rectangles, left/top edge rectangles, right=width-1, bottom=height-1, out-of-bounds right/bottom clamping, and invalid left>right or top>bottom rejection.
Typecheck passes
Debug build passes: cmake --build OmniRDP/build --config Debug
CTest passes: ctest --test-dir OmniRDP/build -C Debug -R "test_viewer_gfx_pipeline|test_viewer_publisher|test_viewer_framebuffer|test_svc_config" --output-on-failure
git diff --check passes

userStories.title: Validate RDPEGFX dirty command bounds
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want RDPEGFX dirty command construction to validate source rectangles and payload bounds before FreeRDP send callbacks are invoked.
acceptanceCriteria: RDPEGFX dirty command builders verify snapshot width, height, stride, pixel buffer size, rectangle bounds, and generated payload length before send.
Invalid dirty command input returns a failure or deferred result without sending StartFrame, SurfaceCommand, or EndFrame for that dirty frame.
WLog_DBG logging reports rejected command bounds with viewer id, generation, rectangle coordinates, surface width, surface height, and reason.
Add tests for invalid rectangles, zero-size rectangles, dimension mismatch, oversized payload prevention, valid one-pixel edge rectangles, and valid full-width/full-height edge rectangles.

userStories.title: Harden per-viewer pending dirty accumulator
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want each RDPEGFX viewer to keep its own pending dirty accumulator so skipped or deferred backend updates cannot lose invalid regions.
acceptanceCriteria: RDPEGFX viewers accumulate dirty rectangles per viewer instead of reading only the global latest framebuffer dirty list when sending dirty updates.
Classic viewers and viewer.gfx.enabled=false behavior remain unchanged.
Accumulator state stores start generation, latest generation, rectangle count, full-frame flag, overflow flag, accumulated area, and update count.
Accumulation ignores generations less than or equal to dirty_last_sent_generation for that viewer.
Add tests for accumulating two generations before send, preserving start/latest generation, ignoring stale generation input, and empty pending move behavior.

CTest passes: ctest --test-dir OmniRDP/build -C Debug -R "test_viewer_gfx_pipeline|test_viewer_publisher|test_viewer_framebuffer|test_svc_config" --output-on-failure
git diff --check passes

userStories.title: Add dirty region union and full-frame thresholds
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want pending RDPEGFX dirty regions to be merged and bounded so sends provide complete coverage without unbounded rectangle growth.
acceptanceCriteria: Dirty rectangles are merged when they overlap or share an edge using inclusive RECTANGLE_16 coordinates.
Pending dirty state switches to one full-frame rectangle when pending rectangle count exceeds 128 rectangles.
Pending dirty state switches to one full-frame rectangle when accumulated dirty area is greater than 60 percent of surface area.
Full-frame fallback uses exactly one rectangle with left=0, top=0, right=width-1, and bottom=height-1.

Add tests for overlap merge, edge-adjacent merge, non-overlap preservation, 129-rectangle overflow fallback, 60-percent area threshold fallback, empty dirty input fallback, and dirty_overflow input fallback.

userStories.title: Fix pending dirty move and remerge race safety
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want moving pending dirty work to a send batch and re-merging deferred work to preserve newer producer updates.
acceptanceCriteria: The viewer loop moves pending dirty state under viewer->gfx.lock only after dirty pacing returns OK.
New dirty updates that arrive while a moved batch is being encoded or sent remain pending in viewer->gfx.
Deferred sends re-merge the moved batch with existing pending dirty state instead of replacing existing pending dirty state.
Dirty sends denied by eligibility checks re-merge the moved batch and signal the viewer wake event if pending work remains.
Add tests for move preserving new updates added after move, deferred remerge preserving both moved and new rectangles, denied-send remerge, and latest generation after remerge.

userStories.title: Send RDPEGFX dirty snapshots from pending batches
userStories.description: As a viewer, I want RDPEGFX incremental updates to use the accumulated pending dirty batch so all skipped or deferred generations are represented in the outgoing dirty frame.
acceptanceCriteria: viewer_gfx_try_send_dirty_update snapshots latest framebuffer pixels after moving a pending dirty batch.
Outgoing snapshot dirty rectangles are replaced by the moved pending batch rectangles or by one full-frame rectangle when the moved batch is full-frame.
Outgoing snapshot generation is set to the moved batch latest generation before eligibility checks and send.
Successful dirty send discards the moved batch; deferred or denied dirty send re-merges it.
Add tests for snapshot generation override, moved batch rectangle override, full-frame moved batch override, successful send clearing moved batch, and deferred send remerge.

userStories.title: Strengthen RDPEGFX ACK and backpressure pacing
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want RDPEGFX dirty sending to respect ACK, in-flight frame, byte, and client-suspension backpressure without dropping pending damage.
acceptanceCriteria: Dirty pacing checks run before moving pending dirty work to a local batch.
ACK timeout, acknowledgement suspension, max in-flight frame limit, and max in-flight byte limit defer dirty sends without clearing pending dirty state.
Backpressure state is stored per viewer and does not affect classic forwarding or other RDPEGFX viewers.
Deferred sends leave pending dirty state present and signal a viewer wake path for retry when pacing allows.
Metrics or WLog_DBG logs include defer reason, in-flight frame count, in-flight byte count, pending latest generation, and pending rectangle count.
Add tests for ACK timeout suspension, ACK resume, byte backpressure, frame-count backpressure, and per-viewer isolation.

userStories.title: Clear RDPEGFX dirty state on baseline and reset
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want baseline and dirty reset paths to clear stale RDPEGFX dirty state so old generations cannot be sent after a full surface refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: Successful RDPEGFX baseline send clears pending dirty accumulator for that viewer.
Dirty state reset clears pending dirty accumulator, dirty frame map, ACK suspension state, dirty_last_sent_generation, and dirty_last_acked_generation for that viewer.
Surface invalidation clears pending dirty accumulator before requiring a new baseline.
Stale ACKs from a previous dirty epoch cannot clear current in-flight dirty state or unsuspend current dirty pacing.
Add tests for baseline clear, dirty reset clear, surface invalidation clear, and stale ACK isolation.

userStories.title: Clear RDPEGFX dirty state on resize reconnect cleanup and fallback
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want resize, reconnect, viewer cleanup, and classic fallback transitions to clear stale RDPEGFX pending dirty state for the affected viewer.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend layout or framebuffer size changes clear pending dirty accumulator for each affected RDPEGFX viewer before scheduling a new baseline.
Viewer cleanup and graphics context uninit clear pending dirty accumulator without leaking heap memory or leaving stale counters.
Classic fallback clears pending dirty accumulator and disables further RDPEGFX dirty accumulation for that viewer.
Pending dirty rectangles from one surface size are never applied to a snapshot with a different width or height.
Add tests for resize clear, cleanup/uninit clear, classic fallback clear, and dimension mismatch pending discard.

userStories.title: Add bounded full-frame fallback controls
userStories.description: As an operator, I want bounded RDPEGFX full-frame fallback controls that recover from extreme incremental damage cases without making full-frame uncompressed updates the default.
acceptanceCriteria: viewer.gfx.diagnostic.full_frame_dirty remains default false and is labeled diagnostic-only in config comments and startup logs.

Threshold-based full-frame fallback is triggered only by pending rectangle count >128, pending area >60 percent of surface area, resize/reset baseline requirement, or three consecutive deferred dirty sends for the same viewer.
Threshold-based full-frame fallback affects only viewer-side RDPEGFX dirty snapshots and does not alter backend codec negotiation or enable backend GFX, RemoteFX, or NSCodec.
Logs distinguish diagnostic forced full-frame dirty from threshold-triggered full-frame fallback and include viewer id, generation, reason, width, and height.
Config defaults preserve current behavior until one of the defined thresholds is reached.
Add tests for default diagnostic false behavior, rect-count threshold, area threshold, resize/reset fallback, and consecutive-defer fallback.

userStories.title: Add RDPEGFX dirty diagnostics and counters
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want counters and targeted logs for RDPEGFX dirty accumulation and sends so corruption, lag, and fallback decisions can be diagnosed from logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Expose or log per-viewer pending dirty rectangle count, pending area, start pending generation, latest pending generation, moved batch latest generation, sent generation, defer reason, full-frame fallback count, and remerge count.
Startup logs include viewer.gfx.enabled, viewer.gfx.codec, viewer.gfx.diagnostic.full_frame_dirty, max pending dirty rectangles, area fallback percent, and consecutive defer fallback count.
Dirty rejection and defer logs use WLog_DBG unless they change RDPEGFX mode or disconnect a viewer.
Mode changes, fallback transitions, and viewer disconnect decisions log at INFO or WARN with viewer id and generation context.
Add tests for counter increments for accumulation, move, remerge, full-frame fallback, and successful send when test hooks exist; otherwise add a focused internal helper test for those counters.

userStories.title: Add runtime validation evidence for uncompressed RDPEGFX
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want repeatable validation evidence proving uncompressed viewer RDPEGFX remains visually aligned during common desktop interactions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create or update a manual validation checklist covering initial baseline, Start menu open and close, window drag, window resize, overlapping windows, text editing, viewer reconnect, and backend desktop resize.

Checklist specifies config values viewer.gfx.enabled=true, viewer.gfx.codec=uncompressed, viewer.gfx.diagnostic.full_frame_dirty=false, backend.gfx.decode_only_enabled=false, and codec.graphics_pipeline=false.
Checklist records pass or fail for ghosting, black fragments, stale window trails, canvas fragmentation, click responsiveness, and reconnect recovery.
Checklist records log evidence for at least one accumulated pending dirty generation, one sent dirty generation, and one case with no unintended full-frame diagnostic forcing.
Document remaining limitations in the checklist file if any validation step fails.
Typecheck passes
Debug build passes: cmake --build OmniRDP/build --config Debug
CTest passes: ctest --test-dir OmniRDP/build -C Debug -R "test_viewer_gfx_pipeline|test_viewer_publisher|test_viewer_framebuffer|test_svc_config" --output-on-failure
git diff --check passes
userStories.notes: Runtime validation failed: baseline and Start menu open/close passed, but window drag triggered repeated pending-area-threshold full-frame fallback storm (885 threshold logs, diagnostic forced full-frame 0) and froze MSTSC. Mitigation implemented to disable area-threshold full-frame promotion for uncompressed RDPEGFX; runtime retest required.

userStories.title: Gate RFX validation behind clean uncompressed RDPEGFX
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want viewer RFX validation to remain gated behind clean uncompressed RDPEGFX validation so codec artifacts are not confused with dirty-region correctness issues.
acceptanceCriteria: viewer.gfx.codec=rfx validation is documented as blocked until US-012 records clean uncompressed RDPEGFX validation.
RFX remains disabled by default and no backend codec negotiation settings are changed.
RFX validation, when run, uses the same dirty accumulator, coordinate convention, lifecycle cleanup, and pacing logic as uncompressed RDPEGFX.
RFX-specific artifacts are documented separately from dirty-region correctness failures.
Existing uncompressed RDPEGFX tests remain required before any RFX validation note can pass.
